notes:
Deadlock: a situation where two or more processes wait forever for resources held by each other.
Four conditions for deadlock: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait. All four must hold together.
Banker's algorithm avoids deadlock by granting a request only if the system stays in a safe state.
Paging divides memory into fixed-size blocks, which removes external fragmentation.
Thrashing happens when a system spends more time swapping pages than executing instructions.
HTTP uses port 80 and HTTPS uses port 443.
tcp reliable hota hai, handshake karta hai. udp fast hai but delivery ki guarantee nahi.

cases.a: Processes wait forever for resources held by each other.

cases.q: How many conditions must hold for deadlock?
cases.a: All four conditions must hold together.

cases.q: TCP aur UDP mein delivery ki guarantee kiski hoti hai?
cases.a: TCP reliable hai, UDP mein delivery ki guarantee nahi hoti.

cases.q: How many conditions are needed for deadlock?
cases.a: Any one of the four conditions is enough.
